identity.title: ALMA Autocorrelation Spectroscopy of Comets: The HCN/H<SUP>13</SUP>CN Ratio in C/2012 S1 (ISON)

paper_type_evidence.quote: we present a new technique employing ALMA autocorrelation data (obtained simultaneously with the interferometric observations), effectively treating the entire 12-m array as a collection of single-dish telescopes.

evidence.quote: We obtained ALMA observations using the Band 7 receiver on 2013 November 17 at a heliocentric distance of 0.54 au and geocentric distance 0.88 au

question.value: Can ALMA main-array autocorrelation spectra recover extended coma emission from comet ISON, and what is the H12CN/H13CN ratio (13C fractionation in cometary HCN)?

evidence.quote: The need for improved constraints on the $^{13}$C fraction in cometary HCN provides motivation for our present study.
It makes use of ALMA data sets ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.A.00033.S and 2013.1.00278.S.
We obtained observations of the protostar IRAS 16293-2422 from the ALMA science archive (project #2013.1.00278.S)
We obtained ALMA observations using the Band 7 receiver on 2013 November 17

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Two settings centered around 350 and 357 GHz; setting 1 HCN and H13CN, setting 2 three CH3OH lines

evidence.quote: The correlator was configured with two frequency settings (centered around 350 and 357 GHz)

arrays.value: 28 active 12-m antennas of the main array

evidence.quote: Twenty-eight 12-m antennas were active and the minimum antenna spacing was 17.3 m

max_recoverable_scale.value: ~5" (interferometric images); primary beam FWHM 16.4" at 354 GHz

evidence.quote: which corresponds to a maximum recoverable angular scale of $\sim$5" in the interferometric images.

sensitivity.value: H13CN RMS 1.4 mK; median Tsys 134 K

evidence.quote: The extremely low (1.4 mK) RMS noise level of our H$^{13}$CN spectrum, with only 45 min of observations
observed during UT 11:31-12:16 and UT 12:30-13:29, respectively

provided.value: Archival single-dish HCO+ spectra of IRAS 16293-2422 (13 spectra, 2008-2017) for validating the autocorrelation method

evidence.quote: we averaged 13 archival HCO$^+$ spectra (observed 2008 to 2017) to produce the comparison spectrum

what.value: Nucleus position used to extract model spectra

evidence.quote: model spectra were extracted at the nucleus position identified by (cite: cor14)

what.value: Collision rates for HCN and CH3OH from LAMDA

evidence.quote: Molecular collision rates for HCN and CH$_3$OH were taken from the Leiden Atomic and Molecular Database (cite: sch05)

what.value: Photodissociation rates for HCN and CH3OH

evidence.quote: Photodissociation rates for HCN and CH$_3$OH were obtained from (cite: cro94).

pipeline_or_manual.value: Standard CASA calibration with JAO-supplied scripts

evidence.quote: The raw ALMA data were initially subject to standard calibration in CASA (cite: jae08), using the scripts supplied by the Joint ALMA Observatory (JAO).

continuum_subtraction.value: Savitsky-Golay filter on line-free spectrum, 51-channel window, order 3 polynomial

evidence.quote: using a 51 channel window and polynomial of order 3.
A water production rate $Q({\rm H_2O}) = 2\times10^{29}$ s$^{-1}$ was used, following (cite: cor14).
For more details regarding single-dish calibration techniques, see (cite: one02).

unstated_but_needed: Which scans/antennas were averaged and any flagging or weighting
Line-free channel ranges for baseline fitting
Model details such as abundance profile and photodissociation scale lengths
Observation details of the interferometric cross-correlation comparison

method.value: Unflag and extract autocorrelation spectra with plotms; (on-off)/off, times Tsys, opacity correction to TA' scale; average over antennas and scans

evidence.quote: Background-subtracted spectra were produced for each individual antenna by taking the quotient: *(on-off)/off*, then converted to antenna temperatures by multiplying by $T_{sys}$
A correction for atmospheric opacity of $e^{\tau_0}/sin(\phi)$ was applied
which we later used as an improvised off-source position for sky subtraction

validation.value: Compared with APEX HCO+ spectra of IRAS 16293-2422; agrees within one standard deviation

evidence.quote: our ALMA autocorrelation spectrum lies within one standard deviation of the APEX spectra (shaded region), confirming the efficacy of our method.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure line intensities and rotational temperature

method.value: Integrate lines; rotational diagram of three CH3OH lines

evidence.quote: Using a rotational diagram analysis (cite: boc94), the best-fitting rotational temperature was found to be $T_{rot}=139\pm29$ K
Using a rotational diagram analysis (cite: boc94), the best-fitting rotational temperature was found to be $T_{rot}=139\pm29$ K

analysis_steps.goal: Non-LTE radiative transfer modeling for production rates

method.value: Modified LIME, statistical equilibrium plus Monte Carlo, Haser spherical coma, collisions with H2O and electrons, fluorescent pumping; fit CH3OH for Tkin then derive Q

evidence.quote: Our model employs a modified version of the Line Modeling Engine (cite: bri10)

key_parameters.value: 5,000 cells Delaunay grid; expansion velocity 1.1 km/s; Tkin 145 K

evidence.quote: The model coma is divided into 5,000 cells on an unstructured Delaunay grid with logarithmic radial sampling.

assumptions.value: H13CN photodissociation and pumping rates same as HCN

evidence.quote: the photodissociation and pumping rates for H$^{13}$CN were assumed to be the same as for HCN

fitting.value: Simultaneous fit of all detected CH3OH transitions for Tkin

evidence.quote: The coma kinetic temperature was derived by simultaneously fitting all the detected CH$_3$OH transitions, resulting in $T_{kin}= 145$ K.

validation.value: Collision rates varied by factor 2 changed line intensities by a few percent; alternative Tkin=100 K model run

evidence.quote: varying them by a factor of 2 and found that the predicted line intensities changed by only a few percent
standard calibration in CASA (cite: jae08)
then extracted using `plotms`
a modified version of the Line Modeling Engine (cite: bri10)
reveal an H$^{12}$CN/H$^{13}$CN ratio of $88 \pm 18$
The corresponding H$^{12}$CN/H$^{13}$CN ratio is $82\pm17$

findings_qualitative.value: Autocorrelation gives ~14x line brightness vs interferometer; H13CN not detectable in cross-correlation data

evidence.quote: Note that H$^{13}$CN was not even detectable in the cross-correlation data

claims.hypothesis: Autocorrelation data recover extended coma emission lost by the interferometer
claims.experiment: Combined autocorrelation spectra of 28 antennas compared with interferometric spectra
claims.result: 14-fold increase in line brightness; first H13CN detection
claims.finding: Autocorrelation spectroscopy is a useful new technique for extended sources

evidence.quote: resulting in a fourteen-fold increase in detected line brightness compared with the interferometer.

claims.hypothesis: HCN in comet ISON shows 13C fractionation
claims.experiment: Non-LTE modeling of HCN and H13CN

evidence.quote: we obtained an H$^{12}$CN/H$^{13}$CN ratio of 88$\pm$18, which matches the terrestrial value of 89

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Tkin=100 K (Trot=90 K from IRAM) alternative model gives ratio 82±17, same conclusion

evidence.quote: we ran alternative models using $T_{rot}=90$ K ($T_{kin}=100$ K)

limitations_admitted.value: Ad-hoc use of phase calibrator scans for sky subtraction leaves standing waves and sky lines and high noise

evidence.quote: Our ad-hoc use of phase calibration scans to subtract the sky and telescope background signal is far from ideal

referee_caveats_inferred: Only three CH3OH lines constrain temperature, which affects Q
Sky-subtraction residuals and 7 degree reference offset introduce systematics

evidence.quote: This technique has been applied to archival observations of comet C/2012 S1 (ISON).

missing_for_reproduction: Radiative transfer code is a modified, unreleased LIME
Exact scan selection and line-integration windows
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: tens to hundreds of GB (raw 28-antenna Band 7 data with autocorrelations)
reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and clear outline, but the modified model and some processing choices are not given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Requires custom modified non-LTE model and unspecified processing details.
